description:
OCHA Common Operational Datasets for Jamaica from HDX: Jamaica - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB v01, source Jamaica Social Development Commission, published by OCHA FISS) and Jamaica - Subnational Population Statistics (COD-PS, 2011 census by sex and age, source Statistical Institute of Jamaica, published by OCHA ROLAC). Collections: parishes (14 admin-1 polygons with the census columns joined), admin0 (country outline with the national totals), population-statistics (the COD-PS tables as one Parquet table). Parish names are the join key for the other catalogs of the UNICEF Hurricane Melissa demo; the COD-AB and COD-PS P-codes disagree for 12 of the 14 parishes and must not be joined. Retrieved from HDX on 2026-09-23; mirrored by CARTO. CC BY 3.0 IGO.

**Disclaimer:** a demonstration of Portolan as cloud-native infrastructure for disseminating open geodatasets. This catalog republishes data from its original publishers in cloud-native formats such as GeoParquet and PMTiles, with STAC metadata — open, standards-based and freely accessible to everyone. It is not an official service of the original publishers, which remain the authoritative source.
